# muxt generate run in the directory of a listed package reads the muxt.json
# above it and fails with the message a run beside muxt.json gives. Nothing is
# written.

cd blog
! muxt generate
cmpenv stderr ../want-err.txt
cd ..
! exists route_paths.go
! exists admin/template_routes.go
! exists blog/template_routes.go

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- muxt.json --
{
	"route_paths": {
		"output_paths_type": "AdminPaths",
		"output_package_paths_type_suffix": "Paths"
	},
	"package_defaults": {
		"use_receiver_type": "Server"
	},
	"packages": {
		"example.com/m/admin": [{}],
		"example.com/m/blog": [{}]
	}
}
-- admin/admin.go --
package admin

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /a Index()").Parse(`<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Index() string { return "a" }
-- blog/blog.go --
package blog

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /b Index()").Parse(`<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Index() string { return "b" }
-- want-err.txt --
Error: route paths name "AdminPaths" is made by both output_paths_type and output_package_paths_type_suffix for package "example.com/m/admin"; change one of them
